items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Well after Elton start taking up saxophone with uh Professor Madata

ctx.x: And he was there that night you didn't make a nickel?

No he wasn't there. No he wasn't there. Elton wasn't there. No, Elton played Boundary over Thomas before I started, because him and Thomas came down here together. Thomas come from up around Los Angeles there somewhere, him and Elton. And they came down here and formed the band down here. Oh I see. Well after Elton start taking up saxophone with uh Professor Madata, well he stopped playing Boundary. Uh huh. And that's where I sat fooling with Thomas.
